description:
# FM TX

Pick an MP3 and a frequency, then listen to it on a handheld radio or walkie-talkie.

Tested on LPD433 walkie-talkie channels. PMR446 and GMRS may also work, but I have not tested either.

Defaults to LPD433 ch 1 - 433.075MHz
name: fmtx_vfo
short_description: Experimental MP3 audio over CC1101 FM.
